pages.intro: NACOSTI is Kenya’s national institution responsible for coordinating, regulating and promoting science, technology and innovation.

sections.title: Our history
sections.body: The Commission was established under the Science, Technology and Innovation Act No. 28 of 2013 to provide leadership for Kenya’s national STI system.

sections.title: Our role today
sections.body: NACOSTI assures quality in research, advises government on STI matters, coordinates national priorities and supports collaboration across institutions.

pages.intro: The Commission’s mandate is to regulate, coordinate and advise on science, technology and innovation in Kenya.

sections.title: Core functions
sections.body: NACOSTI licenses research, registers research institutions, accredits ethics review committees, develops STI priorities and advises national and county governments.

sections.title: Public value
sections.body: These functions protect research participants, improve quality and connect research, innovation and national development.

pages.intro: NACOSTI provides a values-led framework for a productive and ethical national STI ecosystem.

sections.title: Vision
sections.body: A globally competitive science, technology and innovation system for sustainable development.

sections.title: Mission and values
sections.body: We coordinate and regulate STI through excellence, integrity, inclusivity, accountability, professionalism and service to the public.

pages.intro: NACOSTI is committed to delivering consistent, impartial and continually improving services to the STI community.

sections.title: Quality commitment
sections.body: The Commission applies documented processes, legal requirements, evidence-based decisions and stakeholder feedback across its services.

pages.intro: NACOSTI’s corporate objectives translate the national STI mandate into measurable programmes and services.

sections.title: Strategic direction
sections.body: Objectives focus on effective regulation, research quality, policy advice, partnerships, institutional performance and accessible public services.

pages.intro: Find answers about research licensing, institutional registration, ethics review and NACOSTI services.

sections.title: Research licensing
sections.body: Applicants should create an account, provide the required research information and supporting documents, then follow the assessment and payment instructions in the licensing portal.

sections.title: Need more help?
sections.body: Use the contact details in the footer to reach NACOSTI support.
